units.source_text: 源氏此时正在明石女御室中。

en.t: Genji was then in the apartments of the Akashi Consort.

units.source_text: 明石女御所生三皇子年方三岁，

en.t: The Third Prince, born to the Akashi Consort, was just three years old,

units.source_text: 在诸皇子中长得特别秀美，

en.t: and among all the princes he was especially beautiful.

units.source_text: 紫夫人格外疼爱这外孙，抚养在自己身边。

en.t: Lady Murasaki loved this grandson dearly and kept him by her side as she raised him.

units.source_text: 这三皇子从室中走出来，向夕雾叫道：“大将！抱了皇子，到那边去！”

en.t: This Third Prince came out of the room and called to Yugiri, "General! Carry the prince and go over there!"

units.source_text: 他还不大会说话，对自己也用敬语。

en.t: He could not yet speak very well, and even used honorific language for himself.

units.source_text: 夕雾笑道：“你到这里来吧。

en.t: Yugiri laughed and said, "You come over here.

units.source_text: 我怎么可以走过帘前呢？

en.t: How could I possibly walk past the blinds?

units.source_text: 岂非太不懂规矩了吗？”

en.t: Would that not be far too improper?"

units.source_text: 等他走近，便抱了他。

en.t: When the child came near, Yugiri picked him up.

units.source_text: 三皇子对他说道：“别人看不见的，我把你的脸遮住。

en.t: The Third Prince said to him, "No one will see. I will cover your face.

units.source_text: 去！去！”

en.t: Go! Go!"

units.source_text: 就用自己的衣袖来遮住夕雾的脸。

en.t: Then he used his own sleeve to cover Yugiri's face.

units.source_text: 夕雾觉得这孩子非常可爱，便抱他来到了明石女御那里。

en.t: Finding the child utterly charming, Yugiri carried him to the Akashi Consort.

units.source_text: 二皇子和薰君在明石女御那里一同游戏，源氏正在欣赏他们。

en.t: The Second Prince and Lord Kaoru were playing together with the Akashi Consort, and Genji was watching them with pleasure.

units.source_text: 夕雾在屋边把三皇子放下。

en.t: Yugiri set the Third Prince down at the edge of the room.

units.source_text: 二皇子见了，叫道：“我也要大将抱！”

en.t: Seeing this, the Second Prince cried, "I want the General to carry me too!"

units.source_text: 三皇子说：“大将是我的！”

en.t: The Third Prince said, "The General is mine!"

units.source_text: 就拉住夕雾。

en.t: And he clung to Yugiri.

units.source_text: 源氏见了，训斥道：“两个人都没规矩！

en.t: Seeing this, Genji scolded them, "Both of you are behaving badly!

units.source_text: 大将是朝廷的近卫，你们却把他当作私人的侍从而争夺？

en.t: The General is an imperial guard of the court. Are you fighting over him as if he were your private attendant?

units.source_text: 三皇子真不好，常常不肯让哥哥。”

en.t: The Third Prince is very naughty; he never wants to yield to his elder brother."

units.source_text: 便把两人劝开。

en.t: Then he coaxed the two of them apart.

units.source_text: 夕雾也笑道：“二皇子毕竟像个哥哥，肯让弟弟，乖得很。

en.t: Yugiri also laughed and said, "The Second Prince is brotherly after all, yielding to his younger brother so nicely.

units.source_text: 照这年纪，实在聪明得厉害呢！”

en.t: For his age, he is remarkably clever!"

units.source_text: 源氏也笑了，觉得这两个外孙都很可爱。

en.t: Genji laughed too, thinking both of these grandsons very dear.

units.source_text: 于是对夕雾说：“这里太不像样，不应该让公卿坐，到那边去吧。”

en.t: Then he said to Yugiri, "This place is far too disorderly; it is no place to seat a court noble. Let us go over there."

units.source_text: 便想同他往正殿去，但两个小皇子纠缠着，始终不让他们离去。

en.t: He meant to go with him to the main hall, but the two little princes kept clinging to them and would not let them leave.
